repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The IR specifies a one-shot sequence: wait for leak, close valve, then enter an infinite cycle (period 1 MIN) that only sends email. The candidate incorrectly repeats the valve close and email send in the `else` branch, causing extra actions at t=60000. The IR cycle body contains only the email call, not the valve action.
diagnosis.change_summary: Removed the `else` branch entirely. The IR cycle is infinite (`until: null`), so the script must loop forever sending email every minute after the initial setup. The valve close happens only once before the cycle starts.
